note: Every number used by build.py. Each value is quoted in data/sources.json under the source id in 'src'. Nothing here is assumed or modelled.

boc_sell_per_100.unit: RMB per USD 100, bank sells USD to the customer

boc_buy_per_100.unit: RMB per USD 100, bank buys USD from the customer

boc_pub_time.unit: publication time shown on the board

fed_h10_latest.unit: yuan per USD, New York noon buying rate, 2026-11-06

hsbc_tt.unit: RMB per wire, Premier and Advance

hsbc_gt_advance_usd.unit: USD per Global Transfer, Advance; free for Private Banking and Premier

hsbc_edu_advance_usd.unit: USD per education payment, Advance; free for Private Banking and Premier

wise_max_cny.unit: RMB per transfer from a bank app

quota_usd.unit: USD equivalent per person per calendar year

atm_year_cny.unit: RMB equivalent per person per calendar year

atm_day_cny.unit: RMB equivalent per card per day

cash_usd_free.unit: USD per trip without a permit

cash_usd_permit.unit: USD per trip with a bank carrying permit

reconv_day_usd.unit: USD equivalent per day with ID only

prc_fine_pct.unit: percent of the amount, upper limit in ordinary cases

prc_fine_serious_pct.unit: percent of the amount, upper limit in serious cases

prc_carry_fine_pct.unit: percent of the amount, unlawful carrying of foreign exchange

fbar_threshold.unit: USD, aggregate foreign accounts at any time in the year

fbar_nonwillful.unit: USD maximum per late or deficient annual report

fbar_willful_pct.unit: percent of the account balance at the time of the violation

f8938_us_single.unit: USD on the last day of the year, living in the U.S., not filing jointly

f8938_us_joint.unit: USD on the last day of the year, living in the U.S., filing jointly

f8938_abroad_single.unit: USD on the last day of the year, living abroad, not filing jointly

f8938_abroad_joint.unit: USD on the last day of the year, living abroad, filing jointly

f8938_continued.unit: USD additional maximum after IRS notice

f3520_threshold.unit: USD of gifts or bequests from a nonresident alien or foreign estate in a year

f3520_max_pct.unit: percent of the gift or bequest (5 percent per month)

sdo_pct.unit: percent of the highest year-end aggregate balance

prc_iit_flat.unit: interest, dividends, leasing, transfer of assets, incidental income
